source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Panorama sorts explicit ordinals first; natural order then uses special-folder flags and name collation. The historical fix writes in-memory ordinals too and clears them before cross-parent insertion. resetChildOrder removes manual order. Direct tests reorder and reset mixed special/ordinary folders. Fixed ID-based code checks SQL success before updating cached ordinals. Do not infer that the older nsresult return type checked every Execute or that comparator equality edge cases were tested.
title: Folder reordering must keep explicit ordinals and cached order consistent
